components.name: Primary Action
components.description: A confident navy action for navigation and admin workflows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--navy, #0b1a33); color: var(--white, #fff); padding: 12px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font: 700 12px/1.4 var(--font-jakarta, system-ui), sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--navy-2, #132744); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold, #c8973e); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Tracking Action
components.description: The gold call to action paired with the public tracking search.
components.css: .ds-btn-track { background: var(--gold, #c8973e); color: var(--white, #fff); padding: 14px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 700 14px/1.4 var(--font-jakarta, system-ui), sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-track:hover { background: var(--gold-lt, #e0b866); } .ds-btn-track:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--navy, #0b1a33); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-track:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Tracking Input
components.description: A high-visibility white field with a clear focus treatment.
components.html: <label class="ds-search-label" for="ds-tracking">Tracking number</label><input class="ds-search-input" id="ds-tracking" placeholder="Enter your tracking number" />
components.css: .ds-search-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: var(--denim, #5b7c9a); font: 700 12px/1.4 var(--font-jakarta, system-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; background: var(--white, #fff); color: var(--heading, #2e4a66); padding: 14px 16px; border: 2px solid var(--g200, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 10px; font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-jakarta, system-ui), sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--denim, #5b7c9a); opacity: 0.5; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--denim, #5b7c9a); outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(91,124,154,0.2); }

components.name: Tracking Card
components.description: A white, quietly bordered surface for shipment details.
components.css: .ds-tracking-card { background: var(--white, #fff); color: var(--heading, #2e4a66); padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--g200, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-tracking-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 800 20px/1.3 var(--font-jakarta, system-ui), sans-serif; } .ds-tracking-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--denim, #5b7c9a); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-jakarta, system-ui), sans-serif; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: A compact public header link with a quiet hover surface.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; color: var(--denim, #5b7c9a); font: 600 13px/1.4 var(--font-jakarta, system-ui), sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--heading, #2e4a66); background: var(--g100, #f1f5f9); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold, #c8973e); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
PRO SAT’s visual system connects a public tracking experience with the operational tools behind each shipment. Deep navy creates a steady, recognizable frame; gold marks emphasis and moments of action; cool blue-grays keep shipment information calm and easy to scan. The satellite identity gives the logistics brand a specific mark without turning the interface into transport-themed decoration.

Typography and components are direct and practical rather than ornamental. Public pages use generous, centered content widths and a prominent tracking search; admin screens bring the same color and type vocabulary to denser forms and tables. Both remain responsive, with compact mobile navigation and content that reflows rather than shrinking into desktop layouts.
keyCharacteristics: A deep navy foundation with restrained gold emphasis.
Clear, high-weight headings paired with readable, compact supporting text.
White cards and cool gray-blue borders that organize shipment details.
Rounded, touch-friendly controls within a spacious responsive grid.

rules.name: The Navy-First Route Rule
rules.body: Keep navy as the stable anchor for primary navigation and key actions; use gold to distinguish emphasis rather than replacing the anchor.

rules.name: The Legible Label Rule
rules.body: Keep labels compact and clearly subordinate to their values; use weight and restrained tracking for hierarchy, not display-sized uppercase text.

rules.name: The Purposeful Lift Rule
rules.body: Reserve stronger elevation for the hero search card; use borders and surface contrast for ordinary content.

dos: Do use the established navy, gold, and cool blue-gray palette as the shared thread between public pages and admin tools.
Do keep tracking actions, shipment status, and metadata visually distinct through hierarchy, spacing, and restrained color.
Do let content grids and search controls reflow at the existing responsive breakpoints.
Do preserve the PRO SAT satellite mark as the brand identifier.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences for animated page, tracking, and timeline states.
donts: Don't replace the established satellite brand mark with a generic parcel or truck logo.
Don't use the hero’s strongest shadow as the default treatment for every card.
Don't make gold the dominant page background or the default surface for unrelated content.
Don't hide the mobile tracking action when collapsing desktop navigation.
